description:
Subcold is a UK-based consumer appliance brand and the UK’s leading mini fridge specialist, trusted by customers worldwide. We design and sell high-quality mini fridges, beer fridges, wine coolers, and compact refrigeration solutions for homes, offices, gaming setups, hotels, caravans, and lifestyle spaces.

With a strong focus on performance, design, and reliability, Subcold products combine modern aesthetics with energy-efficient and low-noise operation.

What makes us different

  • UK-based brand with dedicated UK customer service

  • UK’s leading mini fridge brand, specialising exclusively in compact refrigeration

  • 600,000+ happy customers worldwide

  • Products sold in 48+ countries, demonstrating strong global demand

  • 4.6 out of 5 star rating on Trustpilot, reflecting consistent customer satisfaction

  • Stylish, space-saving designs built for modern living

  • Energy-efficient and low-noise models ideal for bedrooms, offices, and shared spaces

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn commission on every confirmed sale generated via their unique tracking links. Benefits include:

  • Competitive commission rates

  • Accurate tracking and transparent reporting

  • Strong conversion rates backed by brand trust and social proof

  • High average order values on appliance purchases

  • Regular campaigns, discounts, and seasonal promotions

How to promote us

Affiliates can promote Subcold through:

  • Product reviews and comparison content

  • Home, lifestyle, tech, gaming, and student-living platforms

  • YouTube, social media, and influencer campaigns

  • Voucher, deal, and cashback sites

  • Gift guides and seasonal buying moments

Authentic content that showcases real-life usage and benefits performs especially well.

Other information

  • Approved affiliates receive access to brand assets and product imagery

  • Global affiliate partners welcome

  • Ethical promotion and platform compliance required
payout_period: Approved affiliate commissions are processed and paid at the end of every month, in line with the platform's payment schedule and validation period.
